g.text: C. Observed device execution spans in separately profiled controls
Milliseconds per task; command intervals unioned
Streaming budget512 is unchanged; larger tail only fuses if the whole remaining input fits current budget/capacity.
Both controls allocate batch1024, not the old512-capacity baseline. Compute-buffer cost is reported; no KV-memory win.
Paired contrasts and growth/split controls are in CSV/report, including every regression. Default batch512 unchanged.
